hook: Opened a fresh sleeve just to donate it to the woods.
beats: Birdie: Fresh ball. First one out of the sleeve.
Mulligan: Water's up there on the left.
Birdie: It knows. They always know.
setting: Two babies stand on a tee box, grass behind them, framed waist-up in a single shot.
action: Birdie holds up a shiny new ball proudly and speaks, then Mulligan replies with his bucket hat slipping over his eyes, and Birdie gives a slow deadpan stare on the last line.

dialogue.speaker: Birdie
dialogue.line: Fresh ball. First one out of the sleeve.

dialogue.speaker: Mulligan
dialogue.line: Water's up there on the left.

sound: birdsong, a distant breeze, a tiny sigh
